name: How Do You Know if a Bathroom Remodel Has Proper Waterproofing?

mainEntity.name: How do I tell if a bathroom remodel contractor is using quality waterproofing?
mainEntity.text: How do I tell if a bathroom remodel contractor is using quality waterproofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can tell a lot about a bathroom contractor by how they explain waterproofing. A quality contractor should be able to say exactly what system they use in showers and wet areas, how seams are sealed, how the pan is built, and how the work is tested or inspected before tile goes in. Waterproofing is one of the most important parts of a bathroom remodel because it protects the framing, subfloor, and finishes from hidden moisture damage. Ask whether the contractor uses a full waterproof membrane system, how they handle shower niches and bench seats, and what happens at corners and penetrations. The answer should be specific, not vague. If the contractor treats waterproofing as a minor detail, that is a concern. You should also ask whether the installation follows manufacturer instructions, because product warranties often depend on correct application. A well-built waterproofing system is not visible after the project ends, but it is what helps the bathroom last.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quality waterproofing should be described clearly in the scope, not just implied. Ask what system is being used, how shower pans and wall surfaces are sealed, and whether the work follows manufacturer instructions and inspection requirements. A contractor who cannot explain the waterproofing method in simple terms may be cutting corners.
